pairs: Now Sarai, the wife of Abram,
sed habens ancillam ægyptiam nomine Agar,
But, having an Egyptian handmaid named Hagar,
si forte saltem ex illa suscipiam filios.
so that perhaps I may receive sons of her at least.”
And when he agreed to her supplication,
tulit Agar ægyptiam ancillam suam post annos decem quam habitare cœperant in terra Chanaan:
she took Hagar the Egyptian, her handmaid, ten years after they began to live in the land of Canaan,
et dedit eam viro suo uxorem.
and she gave her to her husband as a wife.
But when she saw that she had conceived,
ego dedi ancillam meam in sinum tuum,
I gave my handmaid into your bosom,
when she saw that she had conceived,
May the Lord judge between me and you.”
Abram responded to her by saying,
ancilla tua in manu tua est, utere ea ut libet.
your handmaid is in your hand to treat as it pleases you.”
And so, when Sarai afflicted her,
Cumque invenisset eam angelus Domini juxta fontem aquæ in solitudine,
And when the Angel of the Lord had found her, near the fountain of water in the wilderness,
qui est in via Sur in deserto,
which is on the way to Shur in the desert,
handmaid of Sarai, where have you come from?
A facie Sarai dominæ meæ ego fugio.
“I flee from the face of Sarai, my mistress.”
And the Angel of the Lord said to her,
and humble yourself under her hand.”
and they will not be numbered because of their multitude.”
and you will give birth to a son.
And you shall call his name Ishmael,
eo quod audierit Dominus afflictionem tuam.
because the Lord has heard your affliction.
He will be a wild man.
His hand will be against all,
and all hands will be against him.
et e regione universorum fratrum suorum figet tabernacula.
And he will pitch his tents away from the region of all his brothers.”
Vocavit autem nomen Domini qui loquebatur ad eam:
Then she called upon the name of the Lord who had spoken to her:
“You are the God who has seen me.”
Profecto hic vidi posteriora videntis me.
“Certainly, here I have seen the back of the one who sees me.”
Propterea appellavit puteum illum Puteum viventis
‘The well of the one who lives and who sees me.’
The same is between Kadesh and Bered.
And Hagar gave birth to a son for Abram,
Octoginta et sex annorum erat Abram quando peperit ei Agar Ismaëlem.
Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar gave birth to Ishmael for him.
